Question ONE relates to Aroha's Ceramics Studio.

Complete the following general journal entries. Narrations have been provided.

Record studio electricity owing: $740.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Studio electricity 740 / Cr Accrued expenses 740.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amounts.

questions.text: Record bad debts to be written off: $644 including GST.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Bad debts 560 / Dr GST (payable) 84 / Cr Accounts receivable 644.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stems. V: Correct amounts ($560 excl GST, $84 GST). C: Correct Dr/Cr.

questions.text:
Complete the insurance (studio) general ledger account showing all entries at 31 March 2025, including a closing entry if relevant.

Opening: 31/03/25 Balance 5,280 Dr.

questions.text: Complete the fully classified Income Statement for Aroha's Ceramics Studio for the year ended 31 March 2025. The total for administrative expenses ($24,180) has been provided.
questions.expectedAnswer: Revenue: Workshop fees received and pottery sales. Less selling and distribution expenses. Less administrative expenses. Net profit.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct figures. S: Correct account names. C: Correct classification. T: Two-step calcs. P: Fit for purpose layout.
